_source: Typed from screenshots of Algoma Self-Service > Course Catalog > Computer Science, pages 1-2 of 4 (taken 2026-10-15). Titles are the short catalog titles. NO section times yet. needs_review = true where the catalog is ambiguous or the Requisites box disagrees with the description. Personal status banners (completed/in progress/planned) are intentionally not recorded.
